references.text: The same chapter that forbids uncovering the nakedness of close relatives establishes the principle of protecting family relationships from sexual immorality
Specifies the punishment for one who takes a woman and her mother - they shall be burned with fire, because it is shameful wickedness (זִמָּה)
A curse is pronounced on anyone who lies with his mother-in-law, related to the prohibition against sexual relations with a woman and her daughter
Introductory principle for the entire passage: no one shall approach any of their close relatives (שְׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ) to uncover nakedness
Ezekiel condemns shameful acts (זִמָּה), including sexual immorality with family members, as one of Jerusalem's sins
